title: The Bear and the Nightingale
author: Katherine Arden
summary: In a snowbound village in medieval Russia, a wild, headstrong girl can see the household spirits that her community leaves offerings for. When a zealous priest arrives and the old customs fade, something dark begins to wake in the forest.
readIf: you like cold, atmospheric fantasy rooted in folklore and a heroine who refuses to be tamed.
skipIf: you want a fast-paced read, as the opening chapters are slow and quietly told.

pairings.reason: Another fairy-tale fantasy based on Slavic story with a wild forest threat and a stubborn heroine.
Another wintry, folklore-heavy novel with a determined girl and ancient powers.
A creepier, more horror-leaning story of a young woman against a threat that hides in old family ways.
